privacy.policy: Only public sample models and repository fixtures are admitted. No client, project or personal data; no credentials in any manifest, recording, receipt or result. Reviewer ids are pseudonymous. Live results stay in the gitignored tests/ai-eval/results folder until a person reviews and promotes a recording.
privacy.automatedScan: check-ai-eval-manifest.mjs recomputes every committed fixture's SHA-256 and size, and refuses e-mail addresses, credential-like tokens and non-empty STEP author/organisation fields in it.

humanReview.note: Awaiting a maintainer's privacy review of the corpus; automated checks are not a substitute.
